newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae modifies governance proposals.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae modifies governance proposals.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae) said Friday its board of directors approved modifications to the corporate governance proposals on which shareholders will vote at a special meeting May 15.
The new proposal will now call for annual election of all holding company directors instead of a staggered board.
The new proposals also eliminate all supermajority requirements.

According to a Sallie Mae news release, the board of directors also rejected a proposal by a group headed by Albert Lord that would have allowed them to seek control of the holding company board at the May 15 meeting. The release said that the majority of the Sallie Mae board strongly urges shareholders not to sign or return any of the proxy cards sent by the Lord group calling for a special meeting.

Under the modified proposals to be voted on May 15, owners of one-third of the outstanding shares could request a special meeing for any purpose. At such a meeting, a majority could replace any directors with or without cause.
